name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 18 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 18 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.92 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
